payload.root_cause: to_money() quantizes with rounding="ROUND_DOWN" instead of ROUND_HALF_UP. ROUND_DOWN truncates toward zero, so a half-cent value like 2.345 becomes 2.34 rather than 2.35. percent_of() delegates to to_money(), so 19.99 * 7.25 / 100 = 1.449275 is likewise truncated to 1.44 instead of rounded half-up to 1.45. The module already imports ROUND_HALF_UP (line 3) but never uses it; the fix is to pass rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP in the quantize call.
